6542.title: Sidebar context updates invalidate unrelated row consumers
6542.rootCauseOneLine: Rename drafts replace the shared controller context, and selection rerenders replace the row-action callback context, invalidating unrelated memoized consumers.

prReviews.topFinding: The diff targets the verified context fan-out, but its code and tests were not executed; palette responsiveness remains unverified.

6542.proposedFix: Stabilize the row-action callback, isolate rename subscriptions to the affected target/editor, and separately profile palette rendering before changing its scheduling.
6542.caveats: Both clean runs measure real provider/hook consumers, not browser paints or complete ThreadRow components. Search latency and reported millisecond improvements were not reproduced. Test source and output are inline; raw artifacts stay outside this public repository. No automated fix: the combined repair crosses existing subsystems.
